name: @fhir-r4/builder
description: Builder classes for building valid FHIR R4 resources in JavaScript/TypeScript with full IntelliSense support

scripts.build: tsup ../src/builder/index.ts ../src/classes/*.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --outDir dist --external @fhir-r4/types && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkg=require('./package.json');const distPkg={...pkg,main:'builder/index.js',module:'builder/index.mjs',types:'builder/index.d.ts',exports:{'.':{'types':'./builder/index.d.ts','import':'./builder/index.mjs','require':'./builder/index.js'}},files:undefined,scripts:undefined,devDependencies:undefined};fs.writeFileSync('./dist/package.json',JSON.stringify(distPkg,null,2))"
